name: Alila Mayakoba
positioning: Riviera Maya resort with two connected sides: a lively beach side and a quieter, wellness-focused lagoon side among the mangroves
best_for: Travelers who want a Caribbean beach stay with a quieter lagoon retreat in the same resort
Wellness seekers drawn to temescal, cenote immersions and Mayan-inspired rituals
Couples and families wanting suites and villas with private plunge pools

facts.text: The Beach side has a social, lively mood, anchored by a beach club, a taqueria and oceanfront dining.
The Lagoon side is a quieter, wellness-focused retreat of mangroves, Spa Alila and immersive culinary experiences.
Suites are decorated in subtle textures and soft neutrals, combining nature with sleek modern design.
The Beach Front Suite has a private plunge pool on its terrace.
The Alila Beach Front Presidential Suite is a three-bedroom, two-story suite with ocean views throughout.
The Earth & Clay ritual centers on applying mineral-rich clay and honey.
The Ixchel Water Blessing is a ritual using water, clay vessels, flowers and the ancestral chants of a Mayan healer.
Alila Moments include outings from the resort to walk among villages and ancient ruins.
Casa Amate is a restaurant in a historic lagoon-side house that was once the residence of the De Leon family.
Na Cocina Local serves Yucatan cuisine from an open kitchen beside the lagoon, surrounded by mangroves.

highlights.text: Alila Mayakoba is set in Mexico's Riviera Maya and combines two connected resort experiences, the Beach and the Lagoon.
The Beach Front Villa spans two floors, with nature-inspired decor and a private terrace with a plunge pool and beachfront views.
Wellness facilities include an authentic temescal steam lodge and a spa with treatments grounded in physical, mental and spiritual wellness.
With traditional healers and spiritual guides, the resort offers cenote immersions, guided ceremonies and energy cleansings rooted in Mayan spirituality.
The Winds of Renewal journey leads to an open cenote for a Mayan water blessing.

considerations.text: Winds of Renewal takes place off property.
Outdoor wellness sessions are subject to weather conditions.
Guests bringing a pet should inform the hotel at least three days before arrival.
